company.description: winfunc provides an AI-native security engineering platform that autonomously finds, triages, exploits, and patches security vulnerabilities across codebases. The platform uses AI agents to perform static and dependency analysis, generate executable proof-of-concept exploits, and deliver patches as pull requests. winfunc supports multiple programming languages and integrates with Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and existing development processes. Its features include AI-assisted vulnerability triage, continuous scanning of commits and pull requests, and analytics for security posture and vulnerability trends. The company also publishes research, vulnerability disclosures, and technical deep dives based on issues discovered by its automated agents.
